releases.name: Version 2.8.0
releases.body:
- Default move speed is now faster, move speed now also affects rotation speed
- Can move the camera up and down now

Thanks MegaPiggy and zhuyifei1999 for the PRs

## Features:
- Added on-screen prompts for all controls (can be hidden in the options menu)
- Added new key (") to toggle hiding the HUD (good for screenshots!)

## Fixes:
- Removed helmet toggle key since it does nothing now (CCU handles this).
- Fixed a bug which locked your controls if you used FreeCam while in a projection pool.

- Updated for Patch 13.
- Fixed input bug when entering the map.
- Now using CCU, and not using my stinky input manager.

releases.name: Add togglable flashlight + refactor
releases.body:
- Added togglable flashlight.
- Allowed switching FOV, enabling/disabling launcher without having to restart the scene.
- Parent to player by default (NH compatibility)
- Refactored project set-up to reflect the current template.
- Stopped using flashlight event to initialize the camera.
